core_obligations: Part (a), conditions (1) and (2): note that nonemptiness of the category is exactly the hypothesis that X is compactifyable, and for two compactifications form the scheme theoretic image of (j_1, j_2) : X -> Xbar_1 x_S Xbar_2 to obtain a third compactification dominating both (proof lines 9333-9346).

Part (a), condition (3): for two morphisms f_1, f_2 : Xbar_1 -> Xbar_2 of compactifications let Xbar be their equalizer; because Xbar_2 -> S is separated the equalizer is a closed subscheme of Xbar_1 and hence proper over S, it carries an open immersion X -> Xbar since both maps restrict to the identity on X, and the inclusion equalizes f_1 and f_2 (proof lines 9347-9357).

Part (b): replace a compactification X -> Xbar by the scheme theoretic closure Xbar' of X in it, in which X is dense and scheme theoretically dense, which is the first condition for initiality; since cofilteredness is already proved, the second condition follows formally (the author flags this categorical exercise as omitted in the delivered text) (proof lines 9360-9371).

Part (c): replace Xbar' by the scheme theoretic closure of j'(X), which does not change the underlying topological space, and apply the partial-section image statement to get f^{-1}(j(X)) = j'(X) (proof lines 9374-9377).
proof_roadmap: Cofilteredness: nonemptiness from compactifyability, domination from the scheme theoretic image in a fibre product, and the equalizer argument using separatedness (proof lines 9333-9357).
Initiality: pass to the scheme theoretic closure and invoke the already proven cofilteredness (proof lines 9360-9371).
The preimage statement follows from the partial-section lemma after passing to a scheme theoretic closure (proof lines 9374-9377).
difficulty_reason: The lemma has three parts: cofilteredness of the category of compactifications of a compactifyable X over a quasi-compact quasi-separated S; initiality of the full subcategory of compactifications whose image is dense and scheme theoretically dense; and the statement that a morphism of compactifications f : Xbar' -> Xbar with j'(X) dense in Xbar' satisfies f^{-1}(j(X)) = j'(X) (statement lines 9315-9330). The proof of (a) verifies the three conditions of the definition of a codirected set in the categorical form: a dominating compactification is built as the scheme theoretic image of X under the diagonal map into a fibre product over S (proof lines 9337-9346), and the equalizer of two morphisms between compactifications is shown to be a closed subscheme of the source, hence proper over S, using only separatedness of the target (proof lines 9347-9357). Part (b) replaces a compactification by the scheme theoretic closure of X inside it, and part (c) reduces to a scheme theoretic image statement for a partial section by replacing Xbar' with the closure of j'(X) (proof lines 9360-9377). The construction of the dominating compactification and the equalizer argument are the non-formal steps, so the claim is H2.
